def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(top):
        out.append([2 if x and bottom[r][c] else 0 for c, x in enumerate(row)])
    return out
PY
